manifest_tree_fingerprint.method: path-sorted git ls-tree records for apps/*/tilo-app.toml

result_semantics.rule: A provider gap is not not_applicable. Unknown applicability remains unknown and receives not_run until qualified.

capability_families.H: Canonical component factories, instance lifecycle and wakes, capability context, resource/action routing, and framework conformance.
capability_families.F: Durable records, file grants and operations, metadata, trash, dialogs, and open-in-app routing.
capability_families.I: Identity, secret storage, accounts, authenticated collaboration, and service authorization.
capability_families.N: Scoped network/account services, cancellation, reconnection, and typed failures.
capability_families.W: Real web engine and native-child-view integration.
capability_families.M: Media decode, playback, audio input/output, capture, and encoding.
capability_families.P: Authorized process/tool launch, PTYs, lifecycle, and platform paths.
capability_families.S: Host integration umbrella; row-specific subcapabilities distinguish ordinary integration, observation, system administration, and privileged system administration.
capability_families.K: OS/ABI-aware package selection, execution bridge, and confinement.

capability_family_reference_semantics.listed: Qualification boundary referenced by the shared contract or existing row prose; listing does not establish applicability, implementation, support, or a host result.
capability_family_reference_semantics.unlisted: Not identified by this source audit; no applicability conclusion is inferred.
capability_family_reference_semantics.result_resolution: Required-category applicability is resolved by required_category_applicability_profile. Per-host results, evidence, and reason are resolved by host_result_profile.

canonical_definition_named_search_a1_v1.interpretation: The search establishes only that it found no named canonical-definition/service-lifecycle symbol in this bounded file/token set. It does not prove absence.

linux.reason: The 2026-09-13 inventory revalidation executed no Linux app qualification and imports no legacy Linux result.
